definitions.explanation: An itchy or tickling sensation on the body.
A feeling of being unable to stay still due to impatience or anticipation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むずむず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むずむず⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くしゃみ→くしゃみ：04428_kushami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}そうだ→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: My nose is tickling and I feel like I'm going to sneeze.
When pollen season comes, my eyes and nose start to itch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{行|い}きたくて→行く：00119_iku⟧むずむず⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm restless and eager to go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦したくて→する：00392_suru⟧むずむず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{待|ま}ちきれなくて→待ちきれる：30367_machikireru⟧、むずむず⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I can't wait for the new game to come out and I'm getting restless.

notes:
USAGE:
むずむず(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧) + verb / むずむず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

The shared image is a small, persistent irritation just under the surface — literal on the skin, figurative in the mind. Both senses describe a state you want to end, not one you enjoy.

SENSE 1 — physical itching:
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むずむず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (skin is itching)
- ⟦{虫刺|むしさ}され→虫刺され：22401_mushisasare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むずむず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (a bug bite is itching)
- ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むずむず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (nose tickles from hay fever)
Typically a light, creeping itch — the kind that makes you want to squirm rather than scratch hard. ⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧ is the plain adjective for a strong itch.

SENSE 2 — psychological restlessness:
- 〜⟦たくて→たい：noentry⟧むずむず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be itching to do something)
- ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦したくて→する：00392_suru⟧むずむず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to feel an urge to do something)
The body-level metaphor stays alive here: the restlessness is felt physically, as an inability to sit still.

MEDICAL:
むずむず⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧⟦{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→症候群：30368_shoukougun⟧ is the standard Japanese name for Restless Leg Syndrome — one of the few places this onomatopoeia appears in formal writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うずうず→うずうず：06757_uzuuzu⟧: itching to act. Only the psychological sense, and the eagerness is stronger and more forward-looking.
- ⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧: itchy. A plain adjective describing the sensation directly, with no restlessness reading.
- ⟦そわそわ→そわそわ：05267_sowasowa⟧: fidgety. Restlessness from nerves, and visible to others; むずむず is felt from inside.
